# The CharliVerse

> The CharliVerse is a shared, evolving world of people, companies, fashion houses, technologies and stories, and the home of two practices, Carrados and Blind Ant.

charli.info is the front door of the CharliVerse, a shared, evolving world of people, companies, fashion houses, technologies and stories created by Charli-Jo Tyrer (they/them). Carrados (https://carrados.com/, design non-fiction) and Blind Ant (https://blind-ant.com/, design fiction by Charlotte Joanne) are practices within it. The Training section, including the Confident with AI course with TAVIP, is real.

All content is CC BY-SA 4.0, and every crawler is welcome, including those that train models. Every page is also available as Markdown at its address plus index.md, or by asking for text/markdown.

## Pages

- [The CharliVerse](https://charli.info/index.md): The CharliVerse is a shared, evolving world of people, companies, fashion houses, technologies and stories, and the home of two practices, Carrados and Blind Ant.
- [Accessibility and conformance statement](https://charli.info/accessibility/index.md): The ZIC conformance statement for charli.info: what is claimed, what was checked, what was not, and any known defects, stated honestly.
- [Charli-Jo Tyrer](https://charli.info/charli-jo/index.md): Charli-Jo Tyrer (they/them), the writer, conceptual artist and accessibility thinker who makes the CharliVerse. This page is real.
- [Training](https://charli.info/training/index.md): Accessible courses and learning resources created by Charli-Jo Tyrer with organisations and communities.
- [Confident with AI](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/index.md): A self-study course for blind and partially sighted people using generative AI confidently, critically and safely.
- [Models, Open Weights and the Changing Frontier](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/further-study/models-and-open-weights/index.md): Optional reading that distinguishes assistants from models and explores closed, open-weight and specialist systems.
- [Philosophy: Knowledge, Testimony and Answer-Shaped Objects](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/further-study/philosophy-of-answer-shaped-objects/index.md): Optional reading about uncertainty, epistemic opacity and warranted reliance.
- [1. Start Here: Your First Five Minutes with AI](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/modules/01-start-here/index.md): Open an AI assistant and get your first useful result.
- [2. Choose an AI Assistant](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/modules/02-choose-an-ai-assistant/index.md): Choose an accessible, affordable place to begin.
- [3. Have Your First Useful Conversation](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/modules/03-first-useful-conversation/index.md): Improve an answer by adding purpose, context and the form you need.
- [4. Everyday Things AI Can Help You Do](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/modules/04-everyday-things-ai-can-do/index.md): Use AI to explain, summarise, draft, compare, plan and brainstorm.
- [5. Know What You Are Holding](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/modules/05-know-what-you-are-holding/index.md): Recognise a useful AI response without mistaking polish or confidence for proof.
- [6. What Happens If It Is Wrong?](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/modules/06-what-happens-if-it-is-wrong/index.md): Use green, amber and red risk bands to decide how much checking is proportionate.
- [7. Check an Answer Without Becoming an Expert](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/modules/07-check-an-answer/index.md): Check the source, date, exact wording, numbers and claim that carry the most weight.
- [8. Choose the Right Kind of Image Tool](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/modules/08-choose-an-image-tool/index.md): Match description, recognition, comparison, private processing or human help to the job.
- [9. Ask for the Description You Need](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/modules/09-ask-for-an-image-description/index.md): Request an overview, literal facts, text, layout, uncertainty or atmosphere according to purpose.
- [10. Judge and Verify an Image Description](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/modules/10-check-an-image-description/index.md): Classify claims as visible, contextual, inferred or unsupported, then verify important details proportionately.
- [11. Read Documents, Forms and Screenshots](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/modules/11-read-documents-forms-and-screenshots/index.md): Recover exact text, reading order and structure without hiding uncertainty.
- [12. Understand Tables, Charts and Slides](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/modules/12-understand-tables-charts-and-slides/index.md): Recover structure, labels, order and values before asking for interpretation.
- [13. Create Your First Image](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/modules/13-create-your-first-image/index.md): Write a brief, generate an image, describe it back and make one deliberate revision.
- [14. Keep Creative Control Without Sight](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/modules/14-creative-control-without-sight/index.md): Use intention, hierarchy and proportionate review to remain the author.
- [15. Create a Comic or Visual Story](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/modules/15-create-a-comic/index.md): Plan story beats, panels, dialogue and continuity, then check reading order.
- [16. Create Animation and Video](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/modules/16-create-animation-and-video/index.md): Plan movement, dialogue, music and sound as one accessible time-based sequence.
- [17. Check and Publish Visual Work Accessibly](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/modules/17-publish-visual-work-accessibly/index.md): Define finished, check proportionately and publish an equivalent accessible experience.
- [Session 1: Getting Useful Answers from AI](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/session-1/index.md): Session 1 of Confident with AI, a three-part course with TAVIP.
- [AI Assistants](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/session-1/ai-assistants/index.md): A TAVIP handbook introducing ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Gemini and Grok, written by Charli-Jo Tyrer.
- [Know What You Are Holding](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/session-1/know-what-you-are-holding/index.md): Answer-shaped objects and the human judgement that makes them useful, by Charli-Jo Tyrer for TAVIP.
- [Session 2: Understanding and Creating Visual Media When You Are Blind](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/session-2/index.md): Session 2 of Confident with AI: a practical manual for blind people using AI to understand, verify and create visual media.
- [Session 3: Using AI Safely](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/session-3/index.md): Session 3 of Confident with AI, a three-part course with TAVIP.
- [General AI Assistants](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/tool-cards/ai-assistants/index.md): Conversation, explanation, writing, research and general assistance.
- [Conversational Image Describers](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/tool-cards/conversational-image-description/index.md): Quick, natural descriptions of photographs, objects and scenes.
- [Human Visual-Assistance Services](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/tool-cards/human-visual-assistance/index.md): Human verification when accuracy or judgement matters.
- [Image Generators](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/tool-cards/image-generators/index.md): Creating and revising still images.
- [Multiple-Model Comparison](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/tool-cards/multiple-model-comparison/index.md): Methods for comparing independent descriptions or answers.
- [Private and On-Device Tools](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/tool-cards/private-and-on-device-tools/index.md): Local processing, offline access and greater control over information.
- [Text and Document Recognition](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/tool-cards/text-and-document-recognition/index.md): Reading text, forms, documents, tables and structured information.
- [Video and Animation Generators](https://charli.info/training/confident-with-ai/tool-cards/video-and-animation-generators/index.md): Creating movement, animation, dialogue, music and video.
